title: Palace to DOH: Fast-track medical aid for indigents

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang has ordered the Department of Health (DOH) to fast-track the processing of legitimate claims under its Medical Assistance to Indigent and Financially Incapacitated Patients (Maifip) program, following complaints of delays that have left some patients waiting months for financial support. Executive Secretary Ralph Recto directed DOH regional directors and participating hospitals
